name: viva-sbml-decomposition resources
description: SBML models used by the decomposition studies, with full Antimony.

sbml-model.name: Teusink 2000 yeast glycolysis
sbml-model.summary: Yeast glycolysis (Teusink et al. 2000), 17 dynamic species; the reference model for the monolithic, split, modular, native, coupled and multirate arms.

sbml-model.name: Multi-organ body (scaled glycolysis replicas)
sbml-model.summary: A body of n organs sharing a blood pool, one Antimony model; parameterized by n_organs (shown here for n=4). Species = 3n+1, reactions = 4n.

sbml-model.name: Lotka-Volterra predator/prey (mean-field)
sbml-model.summary: Deterministic mean-field ODE of the stochastic predator/prey ABM; the reduction that is faithful only at large population scale.
